_comment: Canonical PasskeyCredential and Authenticator wire shapes. PasskeyCredential represents a stored WebAuthn credential for a user. Authenticator represents the internal WebAuthn authenticator state. Serialized from PasskeyCredential and Authenticator (internal/models/auth.go).

clone_warning.description: Whether a potential clone was detected (sign_count regression)

passkey_credential._description: Stored WebAuthn credential for a user. Never exposed to clients.

attestation_type.description: Attestation conveyance preference. Values: none, indirect, direct, enterprise.

transport.description: Authenticator transport methods. Omitted when empty. Values: usb, nfc, internal, hybrid.

authenticator.description: Authenticator state. Conforms to authenticator shape.

last_used_at_unix_ms.description: Last used timestamp as Unix milliseconds. Omitted when zero.
